name: Can wall molding be installed on textured walls?

mainEntity.name: Can wall molding be installed on textured walls?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, wall molding can be installed on textured walls, but the process may require additional attention to achieve a seamless finish. The main challenge is often ensuring a tight seal where the molding meets the textured surface. Depending on the severity of the texture, minor gaps might need to be filled with caulk or spackle to create a smooth transition. Our experienced installers are skilled in working with various wall surfaces and will ensure your molding is installed securely and aesthetically, regardless of the wall texture.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, wall molding can be installed on textured walls, though it may require extra attention to ensure a tight, seamless fit with proper sealing. Our installers handle various wall surfaces effectively.
